_comment: The route table. owner JS = registered by app.js (compared with the real Express router stack by tools/build-overview.js --check); owner Python = the model service (compared with the Flask decorators in model/terucon_model). `derived` rows stand for routes generated from site/site.json. `tryIt` rows get a live button.
intro: Express is the only thing a browser talks to. The Python service is internal: it listens on 127.0.0.1 on a port the system chooses, and Express proxies to it. All API bodies are JSON and every error has the same shape, {error:{code,status,message}}.
errorShape: {"error":{"code":503,"status":"UNAVAILABLE","message":"The model service is still starting. Try again in a moment."}}

routes.response: {version:"1", server:true, google:{configured, mode, projectId, clientEmail, location, error}, models:{...only those set in .env}, segmentation:{engine, edgeRefine, edgeMethod, analysisMaxSide}, sam:{enabled, status, backend, model, interactive, textPrompts, ...}, model:{mode, status, error?}, warnings:[...]}. routes.summary: The public view of site/site.json: names and routes, no file paths, no headers.
routes.response: {name, pages:[{key, label, nav, description, route}], docs:[...], connections}

routes.summary: Forward a generateContent call to Google with the server's credentials.
routes.response: Google's status and body, unchanged, plus X-Terucon-Attempts. Retries 429/500/502/503/504 (up to 4 attempts, Retry-After honoured, capped at 20 s); a 401 refreshes the token once; no answer within 240 s after connecting is 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (not retried); the whole call is capped at 330 s.

routes.summary: Find the surfaces in a photo. Checked by Express, then streamed to POST /segment on the model service.
routes.request: {image: base64 or a data: URL (JPEG or PNG, at most 4096 px on the long side, 80 MB body), options?: {useSam?: boolean, edgeRefine?: boolean, model?: string, location?: string, hint?: string (300 characters)}}
routes.response: {ok:true, width, height, labelMap:{encoding:"zlib-u8"|"zlib-u16le", data: base64}, metas:[{index, label, kind, source, share}], scene, engine, model, notes:[...], hints:[...], timings:{gemini, sam?, edges?}, sam:{used, imageId}}

errors.when: FAILED_PRECONDITION: Google is not configured (Python is not called)
UNAVAILABLE: the model service is starting, missing, off or crashed (the message says which)
The image is missing, cannot be decoded, or is too large
Gemini's outlines were too small, or no surface was large enough
Body over 80 MB

routes.summary: SAM's state, in the shape the Design Studio's settings already speak.
routes.request: No body. When SAM_SERVER_KEY is set: x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer.
routes.response: {status:"ok"|"loading"|"off"|"error"|"unavailable", model, backend, device, interactive:boolean, text_prompts:boolean, error}. Always 200: when the model service is unusable the status is unavailable and error says why.

errors.when: SAM_SERVER_KEY is set and the key is missing or wrong

routes.summary: The Pick tool: clicks or a box in, one mask out.

errors.when: image_id is no longer cached and no image was sent
SAM found nothing at that point
SAM is off, still loading, errored, or the model service is unusable
